summary:
Okta獲利連續超預期、營收逾7.6億美元，身分資安基本面穩健。
• EPS 0.90美元，優於預估0.85美元，意外幅度6.29%
• 營收7.61億美元，維持穩健訂閱成長
• IAM與零信任需求支撐長期動能
• 獲利能力持續改善，本益比86.18倍
ai_view:
訊號穩健正面：EPS連續超預期顯示獲利紀律與營運效率改善，身分資安結構性需求提供支撐。短期業績友善，但營收年增率缺失使成長動能判讀受限，且86.18倍本益比要求高成長維繫。中期關鍵在於新產品線滲透、淨續約率與大型交易。建議追蹤RPO、計費收入、自由現金流利潤率與市占變化，評估在微軟捆綁銷售壓力下的競爭韌性。

需留意：營收年增率未提供，成長斜率能見度有限；微軟與CyberArk等競爭壓力持續；高本益比對任何成長放緩高度敏感

summary_en:
Okta again beat on earnings with revenue over $760M, reflecting steady identity-security fundamentals.
• EPS of $0.90 beat the $0.85 estimate, a 6.29% surprise
• Revenue of $761.0M with steady subscription growth
• IAM and zero-trust demand support long-term momentum
• Continued profitability improvement; PE of 86.18x

ai_view_en:
Solid positive signal: a repeat EPS beat shows earnings discipline and improving efficiency, with structural identity-security demand providing support. Results are friendly near-term, but missing YoY revenue limits reading growth momentum, and 86.18x PE demands sustained high growth. Mid-term hinges on new-product adoption, net retention, and large deals. Track RPO, billings, FCF margin, and share trends to assess competitive resilience against Microsoft's bundling pressure.

Watch：Revenue YoY not disclosed, limiting visibility on the growth slope; Ongoing competitive pressure from Microsoft and CyberArk; High PE is highly sensitive to any growth slowdown
